This is the BBC Master 512 DOS Plus 8x8 system font, with a 1:2 aspect
ratio. It supplies BBC-family bitmap lettering for our Mode 0 presentation,
not a claim of exact BBC Micro MOS ROM or CRT reproduction. The upstream
adaptation uses CP437 and replaces the duplicate pound sign with a backquote.
The preset uses 80x32 cells, white on black. No font modifications were made.
